shared_elements: row of repeated short parallel strokes forming a band
division of the surface into registers by a linear band
justification: Both surfaces organise marks into registers bounded by lines and both include discs, rows of repeated short strokes, and crossed or zigzag linework, which is the most specific correspondence. The decisive difference is technique and content: A is deep, bold relief carving dominated by recognisable animals and a figure, while B is faint, thin incised graffiti that is almost wholly abstract and geometric, with no figural imagery at all.
